g.text: Lab 3.3 — Containers: registry, ACI, Container Apps
One registry feeds two runtimes — the choice between them is about scaling, not about images
Same image in both. What differs is what the platform does when nobody is connected.
ACI — a container as a single task
good for: batch jobs, build agents,
ACA — a container as a service
built on Kubernetes, hidden from you
az CLI — the build happens in Azure, not on your laptop
the failure this lab actually produces
result: the app URL never answers,
# match the port the image listens on
